questions.prompt: May the gods keep our homeland safe from savage enemies!
questions.answer: Utinam dī patriam nostram ā ferīs hostibus servent!

questions.prompt: Would that the general may return victorious from the war!
questions.answer: Utinam dux victor ā bellō redeat!

questions.prompt: May they not abandon the walls besieged by the enemy!
questions.answer: Nē moenia ab hoste obsessa dēserant!

questions.prompt: Oh that I may be a false prophet about these dangers!
questions.answer: Utinam falsus vātēs dē hīs perīculīs sim!

questions.prompt: May the immortal gods grant us a peaceful year!
questions.answer: Dī immortālēs nōbīs placidum annum dent!

questions.prompt: May health and long life be given to you, dear friend!
questions.answer: Utinam salūs et longa vīta tibi, cāre amīce, dentur!

questions.prompt: May the gods prevent so wicked a crime!
questions.answer: Dī tam scelestum facinus prohibeant!

questions.prompt: Would that you were now telling the truth from your heart!
questions.answer: Utinam vēra nunc ex animō dīcerēs!

questions.prompt: Would that our leader were still alive and ruling the city!
questions.answer: Utinam dux noster adhūc vīveret et urbem regeret!

questions.prompt: Would that I possessed the riches of wise Croesus!
questions.answer: Utinam dīvitiās sapientis Croesī possidērem!

questions.prompt: Would that the fields were not lying barren from the drought!
questions.answer: Utinam nē agrī siccitāte sterilēs iacērent!

questions.prompt: Would that you trusted me now, my most faithful comrade!
questions.answer: Utinam mihi nunc, fīdissime comes, crēderēs!

questions.prompt: Would that so great a burden did not press upon my shoulders!
questions.answer: Utinam nē tantum onus umerīs meīs premeret!

questions.prompt: Would that the swift ships were already sailing toward home!
questions.answer: Utinam celerēs nāvēs iam domum nāvigārent!

questions.prompt: Would that the citizens feared the anger of the gods!
questions.answer: Utinam cīvēs īram deōrum timērent!

questions.prompt: Would that Achilles had avoided the arrows of Apollo!
questions.answer: Utinam Achillēs Apollinis sagittās vītāvisset!

questions.prompt: Would that I had never set foot in that treacherous city!
questions.answer: Utinam numquam in illam perfidam urbem pedem intulissem!

questions.prompt: Would that the soldiers had not abandoned their posts in the night!
questions.answer: Utinam nē mīlitēs statiōnēs suās nocte relīquissent!

questions.prompt: Would that we had heeded the warnings of the wise old man!
questions.answer: Utinam monita sapientis senis audīvissēmus!

questions.prompt: Would that the storm had spared the fleet loaded with grain!
questions.answer: Utinam tempestās classī frūmentō onustae pepercisset!

questions.prompt: Would that I had not been born in so cruel an age!
questions.answer: Utinam nē tam crūdēlī saeculō nātus essem!

questions.prompt: May fortune favor the bold sailors on the deep sea!
questions.answer: Fortūna audācibus nautīs in altō marī faveat!

questions.prompt: Would that the traitor had not opened the gates to the enemy!
questions.answer: Utinam nē prōditor portās hostī aperuisset!

questions.prompt: May the kind gods grant a gentle death to the weary old man!
questions.answer: Utinam dī benignī senī fessō lēnem mortem largiantur!

questions.prompt: May our comrades reach the safe harbor before the storm rises!
questions.answer: Utinam comitēs nostrī tūtum portum antequam tempestās surgat petant!

questions.prompt: May the enemy not break through the gates guarded by brave men!
questions.answer: Nē hostēs portās ā virīs fortibus custōdītās perrumpant!

questions.prompt: Oh that the harvest may be abundant this year for the poor farmers!
questions.answer: Utinam messis hōc annō pauperibus agricolīs larga sit!

questions.prompt: Would that the citizens still honored the ancient laws of their ancestors!
questions.answer: Utinam cīvēs adhūc antīquās māiōrum lēgēs colerent!

questions.prompt: Would that the general were not now leading his army into a hopeless battle!
questions.answer: Utinam nē dux nunc exercitum in proelium dēspērātum dūceret!

questions.prompt: Would that the king had listened to the warnings of the faithful seer!
questions.answer: Utinam rēx fīdī vātis monita audīvisset!

questions.prompt: Would that so cruel a tyrant had never seized power over the city!
questions.answer: Utinam tam crūdēlis tyrannus numquam imperium urbis occupāvisset!

questions.prompt: Would that I might see that day when I may give you thanks because you forced me to live!
questions.answer: Vtinam illum diem videam cum tibī̆ agam grātiās quod mē vīvere coēgistī!

questions.prompt: Would that the immortal gods might give you that mind!
questions.answer: Utinam tibi istam mentem dī immortālēs duint!

questions.prompt: Afranius excels in comedy; would that, having laid bare his own character, he had not tainted his plots with the shameful loves of boys.
questions.answer: Togātīs excellit Afrānius; utinam nōn inquināsset argūmenta puerōrum foedīs Amōribus mōrēs suōs fassus.

questions.prompt: And may the gods avert this omen.
questions.answer: Quod dī ōmen āverterint.

questions.prompt: Would you had seen me dead.
questions.answer: Utinam mē mortuum vīdissēs.

questions.prompt: About Menedemus I wish it had been true; about the queen I wish it may be.
questions.answer: Dē Menedēmō vellem vērum fuisset, dē rēgīnā velim vērum sit.

questions.prompt: I hope I may see the day.
questions.answer: utinam illum diem videam.

questions.prompt: Now Jupiter forefend.
questions.answer: nē istūc Iuppiter sīrit.

questions.prompt: May I die, if I am not worried.
questions.answer: peream, nisi sollicitus sum.

questions.prompt: Your state of health worries me, as I hope to live.
questions.answer: sollicitat, ita vīvam, me tua valētūdō.

questions.prompt: As I hope to be saved, I am making great outlays.
questions.answer: ita vīvam, ut maximōs sūmptūs faciō.

questions.prompt: Would that I could be enrolled with you myself, as the third friend.
questions.answer: utinam ego tertius vōbīs amīcus adscrīberer.

questions.prompt: I wish you had seen me dead first.
questions.answer: utinam mē mortuum prius vīdissēs.

questions.prompt: I only wish the man had marched out all his train-bands with him.
questions.answer: utinam ille omnīs sēcum cōpiās ēdūxisset.
